purpose: Verify the complete Student Admin-controlled club establishment lifecycle.
preconditions: An authenticated Student Admin is present; the shared identity registry contains valid students and a valid faculty member; no conflicting club record exists.
action_or_input: Create a club with a valid coordinator, valid co-coordinator, valid Club Faculty Councillor, and an allowed category, then approve that open club.
expected_result: The club is created in the open state, and Student Admin approval changes it to the confirmed state.

purpose: Verify that club creation requires a valid student coordinator.
preconditions: An authenticated Student Admin is present; the proposed coordinator is not a valid student.
action_or_input: Submit club creation with the invalid coordinator.
expected_result: Club creation is rejected and no club record is created.

purpose: Verify that club creation requires a valid student co-coordinator.
preconditions: An authenticated Student Admin is present; the proposed co-coordinator is not a valid student.
action_or_input: Submit club creation with the invalid co-coordinator.
expected_result: Club creation is rejected and no club record is created.

purpose: Verify that club creation requires a valid faculty councillor.
preconditions: An authenticated Student Admin is present; the proposed councillor is not a valid faculty member.
action_or_input: Submit club creation with the invalid Club Faculty Councillor.
expected_result: Club creation is rejected and no club record is created.

purpose: Verify that club category is restricted to the accepted values.
preconditions: An authenticated Student Admin is present.
action_or_input: Submit club creation with a category other than Technical, Sports, or Cultural.
expected_result: Club creation is rejected and no club record is created.

purpose: Verify that incomplete club creation data is rejected.
preconditions: An authenticated Student Admin is present.
action_or_input: Submit club creation with one or more required club data fields missing.
expected_result: Club creation is rejected and no club record is created.

purpose: Verify the membership application lifecycle from open application to confirmed membership.
preconditions: The club is confirmed; the student has no existing application to the club; an applicable Club Head is authenticated.
action_or_input: Have the student apply to the club and then have the applicable Club Head approve the pending application.
expected_result: The application becomes open and then changes to confirmed membership upon approval.

purpose: Verify that membership applications require a confirmed club.
preconditions: A club exists in the open state; an authenticated student has no application to that club.
action_or_input: Submit a membership application to the open club.
expected_result: The application is rejected and no open membership application is created.

purpose: Verify that duplicate applications to the same club are prevented.
preconditions: The club is confirmed; the student already has an open or pending application to that club.
action_or_input: Submit another membership application to the same club.
expected_result: The duplicate application is rejected and no additional application is created.

purpose: Verify that a student may apply to multiple different clubs.
preconditions: Two confirmed clubs exist; the student has no application to the second club.
action_or_input: Submit applications to both confirmed clubs.
expected_result: Separate open applications are created for the student in both clubs.

purpose: Verify that only the applicable Club Head may approve a club membership application.
preconditions: A pending membership application exists for a club; the authenticated actor is not that club's coordinator or co-coordinator.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the pending application.
expected_result: Approval is denied and the membership remains unconfirmed.

purpose: Verify the complete targeted poll creation and participation lifecycle.
preconditions: The Club Head is applicable to the club; at least two choices exist; the target audience contains at least one eligible student; the poll is active.
action_or_input: Create the targeted poll, notify the intended audience, and have an eligible target student cast one vote.
expected_result: The poll becomes open with a defined target audience, the notification is delivered to the intended audience, and the student's vote is recorded.

purpose: Verify that a poll requires at least two choices.
preconditions: An authenticated applicable Club Head is present.
action_or_input: Attempt to create a poll with fewer than two choices.
expected_result: Poll creation is rejected and no poll is made available.

purpose: Verify that poll target groups must be valid.
preconditions: An authenticated applicable Club Head is present.
action_or_input: Attempt to create a poll with invalid or missing target groups.
expected_result: Poll creation is rejected and no poll is made available.

purpose: Verify that students outside the target audience cannot vote.
preconditions: An active poll exists; the authenticated student is not in any selected target group.
action_or_input: Attempt to cast a vote in the poll.
expected_result: The vote is rejected and no vote is recorded for the student.

purpose: Verify that voting is rejected when the poll is not active or has expired.
preconditions: A poll exists but is inactive or past its active period.
action_or_input: Have an otherwise eligible target student attempt to vote.
expected_result: The vote is rejected and no vote is recorded.

purpose: Verify that a student cannot cast more than one vote in the same poll.
preconditions: The poll is active; the student is in the target audience and has already voted.
action_or_input: Attempt to cast a second vote in the same poll.
expected_result: The second vote is rejected and the student's first vote remains unchanged.

source_id: Section 6.2 Venue Scheduling - invalid time range
purpose: Verify that a booking start time must precede its end time.
preconditions: A configured venue is available.
action_or_input: Submit session or event bookings in parameterized cases where the start time equals or follows the end time.
expected_result: Each booking is rejected.

purpose: Verify that overlapping sessions cannot share one venue on the same date.
preconditions: A configured venue has an accepted session during a known time window.
action_or_input: Submit another session in that same venue on the same date with an overlapping time window.
expected_result: The overlapping session is rejected.

purpose: Verify that overlapping events cannot share one venue on the same date.
preconditions: A configured venue has an accepted event during a known time window.
action_or_input: Submit another event in that same venue on the same date with an overlapping time window.
expected_result: The overlapping event is rejected.

purpose: Verify that a session and event cannot overlap in the same venue on the same date.
preconditions: A configured venue has an accepted session or event during a known time window.
action_or_input: Submit the opposite booking type in that venue on the same date with an overlapping time window.
expected_result: The cross-type overlapping booking is rejected.

source_id: Section 6.2 Venue Scheduling - non-overlap true outcome
purpose: Verify that adjacent or otherwise non-overlapping bookings can use the same venue.
preconditions: A configured venue has an accepted booking ending at a known time.
action_or_input: Submit a session or event beginning at or after the existing booking ends.
expected_result: The non-overlapping booking is accepted.

purpose: Verify that club leadership changes retain valid student coordinator and co-coordinator assignments.
preconditions: A confirmed club has valid current leadership; the proposed replacement is a valid student.
action_or_input: Change a coordinator or co-coordinator role to the valid replacement and observe the current leadership assignment.
expected_result: The applicable leadership role is updated and the club retains exactly the valid current coordinator and co-coordinator assignments.

source_id: Section 6.1 Club Governance - invalid leadership false outcome
purpose: Verify that leadership changes cannot assign invalid students.
preconditions: A confirmed club has valid current leadership; the proposed replacement is not a valid student.
action_or_input: Attempt to change the coordinator or co-coordinator role to the invalid student.
expected_result: The leadership change is rejected and the current valid assignment remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify that applications to confirmed clubs are allowed.
preconditions: The club is confirmed and the student has no existing application to it.
action_or_input: Submit a membership application.
expected_result: An open membership application is created for the student and club.

source_id: Section 6.6 Club Budget Requests - non-negative amount
purpose: Verify that club budget requests require a non-negative amount.
preconditions: An authenticated Club Head is submitting a club budget request.
action_or_input: Submit parameterized budget requests with a negative amount and with a zero or positive amount.
expected_result: The negative amount is rejected; the zero or positive amount is accepted subject to the supporting-file requirement.

source_id: Section 6.6 Club Budget Requests - required supporting file
purpose: Verify that budget requests require the supporting file.
preconditions: An authenticated Club Head is submitting a club budget request with a non-negative amount.
action_or_input: Submit parameterized requests with and without the required supporting file.
expected_result: The request missing the supporting file is rejected; the complete request is centrally retained.

source_id: Section 6.7 Club Event Reports - required report file
purpose: Verify that event reports require the required report/details file.
preconditions: An authenticated Club Head is submitting a report for an existing club event.
action_or_input: Submit parameterized reports with and without the required report/details file.
expected_result: The report missing the file is rejected; the complete report is stored centrally.

source_id: Section 6.7 Club Event Reports - faculty councillor access
purpose: Verify that the assigned Club Faculty Councillor can access and review reports for the assigned club.
preconditions: A complete event report is stored for a club and an authenticated faculty member is assigned as that club's Club Faculty Councillor.
action_or_input: Open and review the submitted report as the assigned Club Faculty Councillor.
expected_result: The councillor can access and review the report relevant to the assigned club.

purpose: Verify that a newly booked session triggers notification.
preconditions: A valid session booking is accepted for notification-enabled intended recipients.
action_or_input: Complete a valid session booking.
expected_result: The shared notification service delivers notification of the newly booked session to the intended recipients.

purpose: Verify that a newly booked event triggers notification.
preconditions: A valid event booking is accepted for notification-enabled intended recipients.
action_or_input: Complete a valid event booking.
expected_result: The shared notification service delivers notification of the newly booked event to the intended recipients.
